purpose: Inspect MotionBERT official mesh resource directory; acquire no models, checkpoints or datasets
prior_documentation_open: web tool inaccessible URL; no returned page content or resource body. Count conservatively as1 source access attempt.
allowed_response: HTTP200 text/html only, Content-Encoding identity; reject binary or oversized responses before reading where headers permit. Bounded page text only saved ignored locally.
success: Exact source URL/redirects/headers and bounded body or failure preserved; visible filenames only inventory hints, never proof of auxiliary bytes or provenance equivalence.
stop: After one direct GET no further same-source request in this stage, no guessed Graph API, confirmation URL, mirrored asset, authentication or full archive. Existing claim rejects restart.
boundary: Official directory reachability only; source bodies not independently verified by web-tool failure, not full mesh inference.
